findings.problem: KT37 never asserts the failed copy is absent from the first run's report
findings.scenario: land() printing before copy reports `copied docs/research-cache/x.md` for a copy that failed; KT37 stays green
findings.closure: KT37 asserts OUT37 holds no `copied docs/research-cache/x.md` on the first run, and fails against a print-first land()

findings.problem: read_manifest's `not a JSON object` and `files is not an object` branches have no case
findings.scenario: with either isinstance guard deleted, a .kit-snapshot of [] or {"files":[]} makes close die with a traceback; the suite stays green
findings.closure: two KT cases write [] and {"files":[]} as the snapshot and assert exit 2, `malformed .kit-snapshot`, no Traceback, main unwritten; each fails with its guard removed

findings.problem: the STRICT_TOPS refusal of a symlinked kit-doc top has no case
findings.scenario: a committed docs/stories symlink to an outside dir forks with exit 0 once lines 141-142 are removed; the suite stays green
findings.closure: a KT case commits docs/stories as a symlink to an outside dir and asserts fork exit 2, `symlink in the kit: docs/stories`, no fork; it fails with the STRICT_TOPS check removed

findings.problem: close hashes track and main files during planning with no OSError guard, against the plan's no-traceback contract
findings.scenario: an unreadable track docs/work/<slug>/research.md (chmod 000) makes close exit 1 with a PermissionError traceback
findings.closure: close with an unreadable owned file exits 2 with `kit-track: cannot read <rel>` and no Traceback, nothing written; a KT case pins it

findings.problem: a landed-but-unverified or truncated copy stays at the target; the rerun reports conflict and main keeps the bad bytes
findings.scenario: ENOSPC mid-copy of a new docs/work file, then rerun close: conflict, exit 0, main truncated, good copy only in the sidecar
findings.closure: land() removes a dst it created when the copy fails or does not verify, so the rerun reports `copied`

findings.problem: rollback-incomplete hint names both commands even when only branch -d is pending
findings.scenario: worktree remove succeeds, branch -d fails: the hint's first command fails and && skips the branch deletion
findings.closure: the hint names only the commands still pending

findings.problem: the mechanism table still offers EnterWorktree unscoped, and :196 says kit-track refuses any symlink
findings.scenario: a kit-local reader of the guide's table enters a track with EnterWorktree
findings.closure: the guide row is scoped like Claude_Workflows.md and :196 names symlinks among the copied files

findings.problem: double colon wording shaped by the WT16 pin
findings.closure: the sentence reads cleanly and WT16 still matches

findings.problem: the kit-local cd && ./workflow.sh reads as a command for the current session
findings.scenario: an agent launches a nested session from the table row
findings.closure: the row says the command is handed over, run by hand

findings.problem: copy_tree lacks kit-track's runtime skip names: settings.local.json and .kit-health.jsonl reach targets
findings.scenario: install from the kit tree copies the author's local allows and health log into a target
findings.closure: copy_tree prunes the same runtime names as kit-track, an IN case pins it

findings.problem: KT32/KT46 assert exit 0 only; KT31 only a tracked link; KT38 fork side only; WT18/WT20 loose substrings
findings.scenario: a mutant copying the dereferenced settings.local.json link survives
findings.closure: KT32/KT46 assert the link is absent from the track
